programName: Hybrid Athlete Master Program & Tactical Recovery Manual
targetProfile: 18-Year-Old Hybrid Athlete (179 cm, 70 kg) - Tactical Readiness (Latvian VAD / ISTAR Prep)

dailyBaseline.creatine: 5g daily (post-workout with carbs on training days; with breakfast on rest days)
dailyBaseline.electrolytes: On BJJ (Days 2-3) and Sprint days (Day 6), add 1/4 tsp sea salt (500-700mg sodium) to fluids.

timelines.days1and5: AM Zone 2 run -> Post-AM meal (1 scoop protein + banana + 60-80g oats/rice cakes within 30-45m). PM Heavy lift -> Post-PM meal (1.5 scoops protein + 5g creatine + cream of rice/cereal + juice OR 150g chicken + 1.5 cups white rice within 60m).
timelines.days2and3: Pre-BJJ meal (15:30-16:30): 100g oats in water + 1 scoop protein + banana + honey. Intra-BJJ: 25-35g fast carbs + 1/4 tsp salt in 750ml water. Post-BJJ (21:30): 1 scoop protein + 5g creatine + 2 bananas OR 200g low-fat Greek yogurt + honey + cereal.
timelines.day6: Post-Sprint meal: 3-4 eggs + 2 slices sourdough + 1 banana OR 1.5 scoops protein + 5g creatine + oats + peanut butter.

sleepBlueprint: 3-Minute Post-Session Downshift (21:15): Lie flat, legs elevated, 4s nasal inhale / 6s nasal exhale box breathing.
Post-Training Insulin Spike (21:30): 50-70g fast carbs post-BJJ to crush cortisol.
Thermal Dump Shower (22:15): Warm shower ending with 30-60s cool water.
Bedroom Climate: 16-18°C. Screens off 30-45m before bed.
20-Minute Reset Rule: If awake after 20m, get up to a dim quiet room until sleepy.

weeklySchedule.day1: AM Zone 2 Run | PM Power & ATG Leg + Upper Push/Pull + Arm & Rotator Cuff Finisher A
weeklySchedule.day2: BJJ Gi Training (19:00-21:00) 60-70% Effort + Post-Gi Decompression Flow
weeklySchedule.day3: BJJ No-Gi Training (19:00-21:00) 85-95% Effort + Post-NoGi Decompression Flow
weeklySchedule.day4: Full-Body Joint Mobility, Forearm Recovery, Neck Armor & McGill Reset
weeklySchedule.day5: AM Zone 2 Run | PM Strength-Endurance & Posterior Chain + Upper Push/Pull + Arm & Shoulder Finisher B
weeklySchedule.day6: Max Velocity Sprints & Hill Accelerations + Post-Sprint Reset Flow

day1: Dynamic Warm-up & Joint Priming (8-10m) + Banded External Rotations (2x12/arm)
Tendon Prep: Pause Split Squat Hold (W1: 2x20s, W2: 2x25s, W3: 2x30s, W4: 1x15s deload)
Plyo: Seated Box Vertical Jump (W1-2: 3x5, W3: 3x4, W4: 2x3), Ankle Pogo Hops (W1: 3x12, W2-3: 3x15, W4: 2x10)

Main Lifts: Power Clean / High Pull (W1: 4x5 @52.5kg, W2: 4x4 @55kg, W3: 4x3 @60kg, W4: 2x3 @45kg deload). ATG Bulgarian Split Squat (W1: 3x10 @BW or 2x7.5kg DBs, W2: 3x8 @2x10kg, W3: 3x6 @2x12.5kg, W4: 2x6 @BW)
Superset A (3 Rounds): Plyo Push-Up (1x3-4) -> DB Bench Press (W1: 1x10 @22.5kg, W2: 1x8 @22.5kg, W3: 1x6 @25kg, W4: 1x6 @17.5kg) -> Floor Hollow Body Hold (1x30-45s)
Superset B (3 Rounds): Pull-Ups (W1: 1x10 @BW, W2: 1x8 @BW, W3: 1x6 @BW+2.5kg, W4: 1x5 @BW) -> Hanging Leg Raises (W1-2: 1x12, W3: 1x10, W4: 1x8)
Arm/Shoulder Finisher A: DB Hammer Curls (3x10-12) + Banded Face Pulls (3x15-20 with 1s hold)
details.day2_3: BJJ Sessions + Post-BJJ Decompression Flow (Child's pose lat reach, cobra-to-downward dog, thread the needle, legs-up-wall box breathing)
day4: McGill Big 3 (Curl-up pyramids 10s->8s->6s, Side planks 15-25s, Bird-dogs 3x5 with 8s hold)
Cervical Neck Armor: 4-way manual iso holds (2x12-15s)
Joint Mobility (20m): Right shoulder sleeper stretch, wrist rotations, elbow decompression, thoracic open books, 90/90 hip switches, cossack squats, ankle wall drives
Soft Tissue & Parasympathetic Reset: Foam rolling (8m), couch & pigeon stretches, 3m nasal breathing with legs elevated
day5: Dynamic Warm-up + Side-Lying Powell / Banded Rotations (2x10)
Tendon Prep: Yielding Iso RDL Hold (W1: 2x20s, W2: 2x25s, W3: 2x30s, W4: 1x15s)
Plyo: In-Place Split Jump Switches (W1-2: 3x6, W3: 3x4, W4: 2x4), Lateral Skater Hops (W1-2: 3x5, W3: 3x4, W4: 2x3)

Main Lifts: Zercher Squat (W1: 3x10 @50kg, W2: 3x8 @55kg, W3: 3x6 @57.5kg, W4: 2x6 @42.5kg). RDL (W1: 3x10 @52.5kg, W2: 3x8 @55kg, W3: 3x6 @60kg, W4: 2x6 @45kg). Nordic Hamstring Curls Eccentric (W1: 2x4 assisted, W2: 2x5 with 3s lowering, W3: 3x5 max eccentric control, W4: 1x4 light)
Superset A (3 Rounds): DB Bench Press (W1: 1x10 @22.5kg, W2: 1x8 @22.5kg, W3: 1x6 @25kg, W4: 1x6 @17.5kg) -> Pallof Press (1x8-10/side)
Superset B (3 Rounds): Explosive Inverted Rows (1x3-4) -> Pull-Ups (W1: 1x10 @BW, W2: 1x8 @BW, W3: 1x6 @BW+2.5kg, W4: 1x5 @BW) -> Hanging Knee-to-Elbows (W1-2: 1x10, W3: 1x8, W4: 1x6)
Arm/Shoulder Finisher B: Tricep Rope Pushdowns (3x12-15) + DB Lateral Raises (3x12-15)
day6: Sprint Warm-up (15m) + Hip Mobility / No-Hurdle drills
Elastic Drills: Wall drives (3x5 switches), Sub-max bounding (W1: 3x10m, W2-3: 3x15m, W4: 2x10m)
Max Velocity & Hill Sprints (Alternate weekly Flat 15-20m @90-95% vs Steep Hill 10-15m drives with 90-120s full rest)
Post-Sprint Lengthening Flow (Calf/achilles, hamstring, quad/pelvic tuck stretches, ankle circles)

blocks.name: Functional Strength & Contrast Power (Weeks 5-8)
blocks.rules: Main lifts 4-6 heavy reps (80-88% 1RM). DB Bench progress to 27.5-30kg DBs. Contrast Complexes on Days 1 & 5 (Overcoming iso against pins 3-4s -> 20s rest -> explosive jump 3-4 reps -> 2 mins rest, 3 rounds). Nordic curls 3 sets of 4-6 reps strict eccentric. Sprint distances increase to 20-30m. Week 8 Deload.

blocks.name: Max Explosiveness, Speed & 1RM Peak (Weeks 9-12)
blocks.rules: Main lifts heavy singles/doubles/triples at 1-3 reps (88-92+% 1RM). Nordic curls reduced to 2 sets of 3-4 reps. Introduce Depth Jumps, single-leg bounds, Flying 20s. Day 6: 30m all-out flat sprints + 20m steep hill sprints. Week 12 Deload.

blocks.name: Cycle Reset & Baseline Elevation (Weeks 13-16)
blocks.rules: Recalculate 1RM baselines from Block 3 peak. Restart 4-week wave loading structure at higher baseline. Pre-VAD transition: integrate progressive bi-weekly rucking (10-20kg), 3km timed run pacing, and post-lift push-up burnouts.
